name: fable-code
description: Agentic coding upgrades for any Claude model: persistent project memory, cheap-model delegation (Claude Haiku, Gemini, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint), context guards, and a control pane.

delegateProvider.title: Delegation provider
delegateProvider.description: Where the delegate and digest tools send small tasks: claude (your own session, no key needed), gemini, or openai-compatible (OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, ...).

fastModel.title: Fast Claude model
fastModel.description: The Claude model for delegated work, digests, scouts and automatic memory. An alias such as haiku or sonnet, or a full model id.

geminiApiKey.title: Gemini API key
geminiApiKey.description: Only needed when the provider is gemini. Stored in secure storage.

geminiModel.title: Gemini model
geminiModel.description: The Gemini model id for delegated work.

openaiBaseUrl.title: OpenAI-compatible base URL
openaiBaseUrl.description: Base URL ending in /v1. The default is a local Ollama server.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI-compatible API key
openaiApiKey.description: Bearer key for the endpoint; leave empty for a local server. Stored in secure storage.

openaiModel.title: OpenAI-compatible model
openaiModel.description: The model name the endpoint expects.

autoMemory.title: Automatic memory
autoMemory.description: After substantial turns, the fast Claude model picks out durable project facts and saves them.

readGuardKb.title: Large read guard (KB)
readGuardKb.description: Whole-file Reads above this size are stopped with a cheaper route offered. 0 turns the guard off.

dedupeReads.title: Skip repeated reads
dedupeReads.description: Stop a re-read of an unchanged file the conversation already holds, once. A second try goes through.

showBand.title: Show the status band
showBand.description: Show the fable-code line above the prompt.
